actual_terminal_comparison.scope: offline actual terminal evaluator comparison; never actor or current guard input

current_local_view.scope: local physical sensors, client-owned payloads and immutable delivered messages/ACKs; offline methods are diagnostic capabilities

delivery.scope: Current local refusal only; no fresh full-domain collection or submission attempted.

foreground_activation_cost.scope: All initial and retained activation costs, including original collection and polling; overlaps other reported intervals and is not a separate additive cost.

response_timing_scope: Enqueue to readiness observation; original capture and collection costs are separate, no submission or ACK is performed for advice.
